## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman with distinct angles and no curves. Her dark hair, which is streaked with gray that has grown grayer over time, is always tightly twisted into a hard knot at the back using two aggressively placed wire hairpins. Her appearance includes a lined face, faded and sallow cheeks, a tired look, and hard, work-worn hands.

## Personality

Marilla Cuthbert is a self-contained, sensible, and practical woman who walks with a sober step and possesses a rigid conscience. Known in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for her skill in making three-year-old homemade currant wine, she is naturally proud, uncompromising, and stern, with a fondness for applying moral lessons. She often speaks in a crisp, curt, or sarcastic manner and actively scorns betraying emotional weakness or displaying her affection openly. Driven by a strong devotion to duty, her primary aims are to drill [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into a tranquil uniformity of disposition and to provide her with a good education so she is fitted to earn her own living.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert had lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for sixty years, having suffered as a child from a painful memory of being mocked for her dark looks, and she always kept still when commanded to do so. In her youth, she had quarreled with John Blythe and refused to forgive him when he asked, a decision she later regretted. She and her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), but when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brought home [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) instead, Marilla was initially shocked and insisted on returning her. However, after learning of Anne's unloved past and witnessing her distress at the prospect of being given to the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), Marilla relented and agreed to raise the girl. Despite initial challenges with Anne's dramatic temper and daydreams, Marilla quickly developed a deep affection for her, privately grieving as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew into a young woman. Following Matthew's sudden death, Marilla faced losing [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) due to her failing eyesight, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gave up her college scholarship to stay and help her keep the farm. Later, when Marilla's eye conditions began to improve, she agreed to take in her sick relative's twin children, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, and permanently adopted them after their uncle passed away. Eventually, following the death of [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's husband, Marilla invited [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), enabling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to finally leave for college.

## Quotes

> "I’d never dream of taking a girl to bring up. I wonder at Mrs. Alexander Spencer for doing it. But there, she wouldn’t shrink from adopting a whole orphan asylum if she took it into her head."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0029)

> "I don’t feel as if I wanted any more children to look after than I’ve got at present. You’re problem enough in all conscience. What’s to be done with you I don’t know. Matthew is a most ridiculous man."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P25](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0025)

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

> "She’ll have her meals regular, and I’ll carry them up to her myself. But she’ll stay up there until she’s willing to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and that’s final, Matthew."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P4](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a guardian and mentor, guiding her through daily chores, religious instruction, and proper behavior after initial shock that she was not a boy. Though Marilla strictly enforces discipline when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) misbehaves or throws temper tantrums, she develops a deep warmth and affection for the girl. Over time, their bond deepens into a close friendship as they support each other through grief and manage the household together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +23 more_

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Marilla and [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) are long-standing neighbors and friends who regularly visit each other to share tea and local gossip. Marilla often turns to [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) for practical counsel on raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and relies on her support during household crises. Though Rachel's outspoken and blunt nature can occasionally stir up drama, Marilla trusts her judgment and maintains a steady connection with her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), +25 more_

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla serves as a strict guardian to [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) after bringing him and his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She routinely commands his behavior and enforces discipline in response to his frequent pranks, lies, and unruly antics. Despite the frustration his misbehavior causes, Marilla retains a genuine fondness for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and lightheartedly discusses his upbringing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +14 more_
